name: Licorice tea
description: Licorice root steeped sweet — soothing to the throat, and not for high blood pressure.

tcm.note: Gan cao is neutral and harmonises; it appears in more Chinese formulas than any other herb.

ayurveda.note: Yashtimadhu is shita and madhura — a classical throat and gut soother.

unani.note: Sus is barid-ratab in Unani, a standard demulcent.

histamine.note: Very low. Licorice raises blood pressure with regular use, which is a real caution unrelated to histamine.

nutrition.highlight: in more formulas than any herb
